name: ImageCAS
description: Coronary artery segmentation from CT angiography images to measure the accuracy and robustness of vessel segmentation methods.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (F1) and IoU; surface/shape metrics such as Hausdorff distance are also used
reputation: Used within the cardiac imaging community for evaluating coronary artery segmentation methods; recognized but more niche than large public medical benchmarks.
notes: Medical imaging dataset with annotation variability and clinical sensitivity; often limited sample sizes and potential class imbalance; non‑LLM benchmark.
